about: The library the engine composes from, as the addon holds it (tools/gen-engine.lua): Library.lua's moves by id with the tags the engine reads, Progress.lua's ladders (each rung's record window lo-hi and the windows some moves have instead), the Trial's order, the families' pattern priors (Engine.lua ns.FIT) and the tunables (Constants.lua) the engine, the fold, the rung rules, the count's limits, the pain flags and the timers' marks read, and the feedback page's caps (feedback_days, feedback_moves_max, feedback_max_chars: contract/feedback-api.yaml). A flow move's secs are each side's on a side move (side: one side, then the other, so its slot runs 2 x secs; each side its own run with a countdown between them, a flow's side ending by its clock, a hold's counting up past its goal until Done, a move of reps' when the player presses Switch sides, the weaker side counted, on every side move since 2026-10-13); pairs marks a move of reps whose sides take turns every rep, no side move, one count a rep on each side, so one stopwatch covers both sides (its censor on half of it: Progress.lua ns.Classify); regress names the move's regression, the chain Swap's easier version walks down; optIn marks a move offered only once the player checks it (the headstand; the profile's include); mp the muscles it trains as primary (contract/sheet.json's muscles, Library.lua's mp: Hero's body map takes its colour from them, Stats.lua trainMuscles). Since slice 21 every ladder id from 1 is listed with its kind (strength, cardio, pose, retired: the pull and the core hold, no rungs) and each rung's step on the one 14-step scale (12 until 2026-10-05); strengthOrder and poseOrder are the orders the engine walks them in; split gives each retired id the ladder each of its old rungs' anchors went to (rungs), the ladders that took its moves (to) and their steps as they stood at the split, up to step 8 (steps: an old rung lands on the highest rung at or under its step there, whatever a later re-step), for reading an older app's rows (DB.lua ns.Translate); merged gives each move merged into another on 2026-10-04 (an id never reused, no longer in moves) the move that took it: an older app's row of it is that move's, at that move's own rung where it was dosed above it (never a cardio row, whose rung is the player's cardio rung); sided gives each hold that switches sides since 2026-10-10 the unix time it began to (a set of it from before held both sides on one clock and reads as half its seconds, each side's, its correction too: DB.lua ns.Translate); shifted gives each ladder that lost its first rung the unix time it went (the wall sit's 135° sit, 2026-10-26): a row of it from before reads one rung lower, the first as the first (its XP at the rung it was written at; a step mastered at the first rung masters nothing; DB.lua ns.ShiftRow), and a sheet summary before version 6 reads its lad and lu rungs one lower and its ear from the rung that is first now, the first rung's day kept (Stats.lua ns.ShiftSummary); regionLadder the ladder a region scales by (a move off the ladders takes its colour and reach there). Since slice 22 (version 3) a ladder's opens names the ladder and the step a family waits for before it is offered (Progress.lua ns.Open: since 2026-10-05 a strength step is done when the anchor of the rung at that step has a record at its window's lo, a cardio step when the cardio ladder reaches it), a rung's alt also gives a variant counted in another unit its own window, and the constants carry quality_by_step (a step's colour, 0 Starter to 6 Artifact since 2026-10-05, 5 Legendary before: an orange or gold rung asks for another move of its ladder on a rung of Epic or above, at or under the rung the player stands on, at its window's top, takes unlock_days_tendon days where its anchor is flagged tendon, and is never reached by a placement or a plateau; since 2026-10-09 its climb only opens it, and the player's first fresh set of a move of its own level at its window's floor, a countable form's count's floor, or a pose's mark held whole and answered Perfect earns it, and a rung's needs names the ladders and the steps its climb waits for, each done as an opens step is; since 2026-10-10 an opens or a need may name a count, the record the step's anchor must reach in place of its window's floor (a twin with its own window: the count times its top over the anchor's, rounded up), a need of a pose or cardio step is done when that ladder's best rung reaches the step, a rung's proof lists the moves of the ladder at or under it one of which the climb from it also waits for at the top of its own window (in place of the orange or gold rule above), a placement climbs at once from its window's top only on the ladder's first record or after a break, and neither a placement nor a plateau climbs to a rung whose anchor is flagged skill or tendon; since 2026-10-12 a rung's proofAll waits for every move its proof lists that the setup offers, a pose family's rung may list poses as its proof, each proven by its mark answered close enough on unlock_days game days, and a counted cardio rung countable forms, each proven by a count at the top of its window, an opens or a need may name a move whose record at its count does the step, a pose step is done once its family stands above it or its pose's mark counted on a game day, and a loaded move's set counts toward a climb only at kg[2] or more). Since slice 27 (version 4) a move's ms names the muscles it trains as secondary (Library.lua's ms, half a move on the body map's week), a ladder's stat the stat it feeds (Progress.lua's ns.Ladders stat, ns.LadderStat), and the constants carry the sheet fold's (Stats.lua: XP and levels, the rested pool, the streak and its rest tokens, Welcome back, the vault, the stats, familiarity, the skills, the ratings, the body map's steps, the retired titles' date), so the cores fold the app's own sheet by the game's rules; since slice 30 they carry focus_level, the level from which the apps ask once for the player's focus (Sheet.lua's ask); since slice 32 streak_milestones, the streak's milestone days (the largest one a game day's streak reaches or passes is its milestone), and the phones' reminders' and sitting cue's (remind_*: the daily cap's default and most, quiet hours and the streak reminder's time in minutes after local midnight, the most reminders a player sets, Android's window, the retry, the days the iPhone plans ahead, and since 2026-10-09 the streak reminder's taper after an absence: the game days without a performed move after which it comes only every remind_taper_every game days, and from which once a week; sit_*: the hour's steps under which the cue offers a pump and its least spacing in minutes), and since slice 33 the phones' game links' (link_*: the look at each link's feed in seconds while the app is in front, the background refresh's earliest spacing, the age past which a finish offers nothing, the least spacing between two game offers and the age from which an offer says how long ago the game finished, in minutes), which the addon does not read; since slice 35 the desktop app's match offers' (match_*: the card's and the match_end command's life in minutes, the least a game watched by its process runs before its close offers and the wait for its relaunch, in seconds; since slice 48 match_sat_min, the minutes sat at the computer from which a match's pump opens on its warm move (slice 57; from which a match's end asked until then), match_step_min, the minutes a size step of a match's own minutes takes, half up from Small to Big, and match_min_league_s, the least League of Legends' game process runs before its close offers; since slice 59 match_lead_league_min, the minutes before League's game process started from which its match counts, champion select, never from before League's previous close, the latest move or the latest return to the computer; since slice 48's double-check match_away_s, the seconds of no input at the computer while a match offer's card shows after which the offer goes to the phone and the watch; since 2026-11-04 match_short_min, the minutes under which a match's pump composes at the Light pace, one move, on every device), which the addon does not read either, pace_moves (the moves a Small, Normal and Big pump gives at each pace: Moves per quest's, and since slice 48 Moves per match's on every device, docs/computer-games.md), and the pause's lengths (pause_hour_s, pause_four_hours_s: the pause for an hour and for four hours, in seconds); since 2026-10-09 Pro's Path's (path_climbs, the dated climbs from which a ladder's pace shows, and path_units, the days under which it counts in days, weeks and months, else in years), which the addon does not read. The phone apps bundle it for the free game-agnostic mode, and the helper builds it in for the desktop app's offers and their pause (the match_*, pause_*, remind_cap, remind_cap_max, remind_quiet_from_min, remind_quiet_to_min, link_gap_min and link_offer_max_min keys) and, since 2026-10-09, its reminders and its Result's streak milestone (remind_streak_min, remind_taper_days, remind_taper_every, remind_weekly_days, sit_after_min and streak_milestones; since 2026-10-27 remind_run_min, the minutes it has run in this run before its streak reminder shows), its weekly vault's goals (vault_moves, vault_records and vault_embers) and since slice 55 the "Cardio done today" Toast's day (embers_day). Since 2026-10-09 owed_fresh_days: the game days past which an unfinished move puts no dot on the apps' Pump tab and makes Catch up no primary (the phones and the desktop app read it, the addon does not); and the voice's callouts' rule base (callout_order: the facts, the most specific first; callout_takes: each fact's takes, a milestone's per milestone; callout_last_moves: the least pump whose last move has one; callout_gap_s: the pause before it), which the phones and the desktop app pick a move's callout by. Since 2026-10-09 a move's load ("total", or "each": a weight in each hand, the kg of one) marks a rep move that takes a typed weight, kg its first set's start range in whole kg, holds the gear that carries its load best first (the implement: Progress.lua ns.Implement) and upgrade the moves that take its place in a pump whose candidates hold one of them (ns.Better; Swap's backup skips a move one of them that passes the filters would take the place of, ns.BetterOpen); loadKind is the row kind of a set's weight (its reps the weight in tenths of a kg, written just before the set row), and the constants carry the weights' rules (load_*: Epley's constant, the top reps and the fresh sets at it before a step up, the step in % and in whole kg, a barbell's step, the kettlebell sizes, the most the weight box takes, and since 2026-10-10 load_floor_reps: a step up only where the form's strength makes that many reps at the heavier weight, and load_box_step: the weight box's - and + in tenths of a kg, Progress.lua ns.LoadStep; really_load: a weight above that many times the planned one asks again). Since 2026-10-15 the Saga's day (contract/fixtures/history.json `saga`, which states the rules): best_day_min_days, the earlier game days with a move a day needs before it gets a quality word or a best day; day_rank_days, the calendar game days before a day its quality looks back over; day_rank_shares, the percent of those days that may have more moves for Epic, Rare and Uncommon (else Common); the game's fold reads them too. Since 2026-10-16 the games and apps on the phone (docs/phone-games.md), which the phones read and the addon does not: phone_rejoin_s, the seconds a watched game may stay away from the front and keep its session; phone_min_default_min and phone_min_max_min, the Shortest session's default and most in minutes (a shorter session offers nothing); phone_match_guess_min, a game's minutes per match before any answer; phone_match_answers, the answers whose median minutes per match the guess takes; phone_matches_max, the most matches the "Good game!" sheet counts; pump_first_open_min, the minutes Pump first's one tap opens an app that waits for today's pump. Since slice 44 the phones' sheet imports, of which the addon reads the first alone, its own import's cap, since 2026-10-31: import_max_chars, the most UTF-16 code units a pasted, scanned, linked or shared text may hold, counted as it arrived; import_max_unpacked, the most bytes its Base64 and raw DEFLATE may unpack to, the unpacking stopped once past it; either refused before anything of it is read; import_max_items, the most items its CBOR may decode to (each item read counts one, a tag and its content each, a map's key and its value each, and a byte string that is no UTF-8 text one more for each of its bytes, which become numbers), the decoding stopped once past it. Each refuses the text as too long. Since 2026-10-31 the times a row from outside a device's own writing may carry, which the helper and both phones read and the game too: a row dated before row_min_ts (unix seconds, before QuestPump wrote any row) or more than row_ahead_s past the reading device's own clock is refused, and a row that floors or locks (a reset, a phone's Start over among them, or a felt-unwell row) more than row_ahead_floor_s past it: an import string that holds one whole, a backup file's, a synced batch's, the helper's copy's and the helper's game rows' one by one, and a catch-up dated there whole; the phones hold a backup file's pumps by their starts and their moves' (unix ms, read in whole seconds) as any other row. Since slice 42 (2026-10-16, version 5) a rung's path (Progress.lua ns.Ladders `path`, in place of proof and proofAll and of the Epic rule under an orange or gold rung) lists the stages the climb from it waits for, in order, each { ids: its moves, any one of which does it, opens: "step" (offered with the step), "main" (once the rung's main move reached its top once), a move id (once that move did), or none (once a move of the stage before it did, past a stage the setup shuts every move of; the main move for the first), days: the game days at its top it takes, unlock_days unless named (a cardio form's clean days) }; a stage the setup (with no pain flag) shuts every move of is skipped, and a ladder that stood above the rung has every stage done (ns.PathIn, ns.Stages); a move's top is its own window's top, a pose's goal pose answered as the climb counts (ns.MarkNeeds), a countable form's clean window (ns.MoveTop); a move's checks name the steps it waits for before a pump, Swap or a Start offers it (ns.MoveOpen), as a rung's needs do for its climb; an entry of opens (a list now: every one), needs or checks is { ladder, step, count?, move?, mark? }, mark a pose's least answer on one game day, or { any: [ entries ] }, done when one is; a move's goal marks a pose with a goal pose (ns.HasGoal); count is true on a countable form (its window of counts until then, no goal and no climb since); the constants carry cardio_clean_days, the clean days a counted rung's climb takes by its step, and cardio_full_days a timed rung's full moves (slice 52; cardio_rung_days, its ready days, cardio_rung_up and count_gap_h went); since slice 52 the steady ledger's (ledger_*: Progress.lua ns.SteadyLedger, DB.lua steadyRow) with ledger_ln, the centi-log ns.LN[s] of s = 1-1000 at index s - 1 (ns.EXP the s whose centi-log is nearest, the lower on a tie, 1 at or under 0), in place of the cardio progression P's p_*, and keep_going_s, the last seconds of a steady move in which Keep going shows. A move's hint (2026-10-17) is the id of the pose that helps it, a soft line on its card and never a gate (contract/moves.json's hint its advice, where it has one), and a move's goalSince the unix time its form changed (2026-10-17, slice 42's review: the wall angels', whose goal pose became the wall test; 2026-10-19, the program's double-check: the plank shoulder taps', whose feet came together on 2026-10-18): an older row of it keeps the record and its stars but counts toward no recent form (ns.Form: the next set a max set until one on the new form), no day at the top, no mark day, no closest answer and no first pass (DB.lua ns.BeforeForm, recordCount, anchorAttempt, markDays), and no step's need or check counts such a move's record (tools/lint.lua). Since slice 54 (2026-10-23) a cardio form's road (roads, in the wheel's order: run, strike, jump, floor, standing, then gear for the forms with needs) orders the cardio picks' fair draw and a step's forms, a core or side hold's facing (facings: front, side, back) orders the four winds by facing_share, and omens are the week's omens in the wheel's order, each { key, road }: the week's omen is omens[week % 5], passed on past an omen no form of whose road the steady pool on the setup holds at the player's cardio rung (ns.Omen, ns.SteadyForms: the cardio forms not endOnly of rung min(rung, 6) and the two rungs below it, lower while the setup leaves none; since 2026-10-24), the floor move's road's omen where none is; its road comes first in the fair draw and its key names the vault's week, and it says no cue on a move (a cue a steady move of its road said after its pace, slice 54 until 2026-11-03, with a sore cue under some pain flags). Since 2026-10-27 the weekly vault's first goal is the moves done (vault_moves: every performed move row the fold applies counts one, an unfinished move paid too, in place of vault_pumps' 20 pumps counted at their first fresh move), the sheet summary's va[1] and lv's goal 1. Since slice 55 (2026-10-23) the weekly vault's third goal is the embers' (vault_embers: the needs of its three tiers, each paid xp_vault_goal, in place of vault_cardio_min's 10 cardio minutes), embers_day the most embers a game day lights (Stats.lua ns.LightsEmber), and long_haul_s and long_haul_days the Long Haul's lengths in seconds and the game days with a Yes at the open length that open the next (its row a steady cardio row whose reps hold its planned seconds: DB.lua ns.HaulRow). Since slice 52 holdGoal lists the Stamina Ledger's hold ladders (ns.HOLD_GOAL), whose fresh holds may ask "Could you have held longer?" (ns.HoldAsk), the answer in the hold row's reps (ns.Enum.longer, 0 not asked). Since slice 67 (2026-11-07) work mode's, which the desktop app, the phones and the browser read and the addon does not: sit_away_s, the seconds of no input (or between two looks) after which the sitting clock's minutes start again at zero, the work clock's on every device that counts presence too; work_every_min, Every's default, the minutes of the player's own time at it after which a work pump is due, counted from the shared anchor (Start, any pump done on any device, Later); work_every_choices, the lengths Every offers, the first the default (every work pump is pace_moves[pace][2] moves at work mode's own Moves per block, Engine.lua workQuota: no set of them and no long one since 2026-11-11); work_moment_s, the seconds without input at the computer at which a due work pump asks; work_late_s, the seconds after it was due at which it asks anyway; work_warm_min, the minutes on the device's sitting clock from which a work pump opens on its warm move; bank_quest_min, the least bank number, which an owed row a device without a computer banks carries in its questID (the number plus the first eight hex digits of the pump id's UUID modulo the number; contract/sync-api.yaml, "The account's unfinished list").
